Let me look carefully at the image. There's a person's right hand holding a small screw. In front of the hand is a bin containing small screws (no dividers visible, just loose screws). To the left and below, there are other bins.

Let me look at the bins with black dividers. I see one bin at the top left that has a single black divider (one black strip). Let me look more carefully. The bin at the bottom left (partially visible) has one black divider.

Let me count bins with two black dividers. The bottom middle bin clearly has two black dividers. Are there others? The top left bin has one black divider. The bottom left bin has one black divider. So only one bin with two black dividers is visible. So option C says "at least three bins with two black dividers" which is false.

Option A: "The person can put the screw in a bin with two black dividers if they lower their body." The hand is at a certain height. The bin with two black dividers is below the hand. The hand is holding the screw at the level of the bin in front (the one with loose screws). To put the screw in the bin with two dividers, the hand would need to move down, not the body lowered. Lowering the body doesn't make sense because the hand position relative to the bins is what matters; the person's arm can reach down. So A is not correct.

Option B: "The person can put the screw in the bin directly in front of the person if the right hand is moved forward and to the right." The bin directly in front of the person is the one with loose screws (the open bin the hand is near). The hand is currently holding the screw just to the left of that bin's opening. To deposit the screw into that bin, the hand would move forward (toward the bin) and to the right (the bin opening is to the right of the hand). Yes, the hand is at the left edge of that bin. Moving forward and right would place the screw into the bin. That seems correct.

Let me double check the geometry. The hand's fingers are holding the screw at the front-left corner of the bin. The bin opening extends to the right and forward. So moving the hand forward and to the right would drop the screw into the bin. Yes.

Thus B is correct.

Let me double check C again. Visible bins: top bin (partially visible at very top, no dividers seen). Upper-left bin: one black divider. Middle bin (front, with loose screws): no dividers. Middle-left bin (behind hand, partially visible): no dividers visible. Bottom-left bin: one black divider. Bottom-middle bin: two black dividers. So only one bin with two dividers. C false.

Thus answer B.

The instruction: answer directly with only the letter.

So final: B.
